use_cases.name: User Login
use_cases.description:
1. Client: Sends POST request to /rest/user/login with email and password
2. Login Handler: Queries database for user with matching email and hashed password (routes/login.ts)
3. Login Handler: Checks if user has TOTP secret set (routes/login.ts)
4. Login Handler: If TOTP secret exists, returns temporary token for 2FA verification (routes/login.ts)
5. Login Handler: If no TOTP secret, creates authenticated user session and returns JWT token (routes/login.ts)
6. Client: Stores JWT token in localStorage and cookie (frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts)

use_cases.name: User Registration
use_cases.description:
1. Client: Sends POST request to /api/Users with user details including email, password, security question, and answer
2. Registration Handler: Creates new user in database with hashed password (routes/authenticatedUsers.ts)
3. Registration Handler: Saves security answer for password reset functionality (routes/authenticatedUsers.ts)
4. Client: Redirects to login page after successful registration (frontend/src/app/register/register.component.ts)

use_cases.name: User Registration
use_cases.description:
1. Client: Sends POST request to /api/Users with user details including email, password, and password repeat
2. Server: Validates registration inputs and checks for challenges like empty user registration (routes/verify.ts)
3. Server: Creates new user in database with hashed password using finale-generated API (server.ts)
4. Client: Redirects to login page after successful registration (frontend/src/app/register/register.component.ts)

use_cases.name: Password Reset
use_cases.description:
1. Client: Sends POST request to /rest/user/reset-password with email, security answer, and new password
2. Reset Handler: Verifies security answer against stored answer in database (routes/resetPassword.ts)
3. Reset Handler: Updates user password with new hashed password (routes/resetPassword.ts)
4. Client: Displays success message after password reset (frontend/src/app/forgot-password/forgot-password.component.ts)

use_cases.name: Two-Factor Authentication
use_cases.description:
1. Client: Sends GET request to /rest/2fa/status to check 2FA status
2. 2FA Handler: Checks if user has 2FA enabled and returns setup information if not (routes/2fa.ts)
3. Client: Sends POST request to /rest/2fa/setup with password, setup token, and initial TOTP token
4. 2FA Handler: Validates password and setup token, verifies initial TOTP token (routes/2fa.ts)
5. 2FA Handler: Updates user record with TOTP secret (routes/2fa.ts)
6. Client: Sends POST request to /rest/2fa/verify with temp token and TOTP token
7. 2FA Handler: Verifies TOTP token against user's secret (routes/2fa.ts)
8. 2FA Handler: Returns final JWT token for authenticated session (routes/2fa.ts)

use_cases.name: Change Password
use_cases.description:
1. Client: Sends GET request to /rest/user/change-password with current and new passwords
2. Change Password Handler: Verifies user is authenticated and validates current password (routes/changePassword.ts)
3. Change Password Handler: Updates user password with new hashed password (routes/changePassword.ts)
4. Client: Displays success message after password change (frontend/src/app/change-password/change-password.component.ts)

use_cases.name: Security Question Retrieval
use_cases.description:
1. Client: Sends GET request to /rest/user/security-question with user email
2. Security Question Handler: Looks up user's security question in database (routes/securityQuestion.ts)
3. Security Question Handler: Returns security question to client (routes/securityQuestion.ts)
4. Client: Displays security question to user for password reset (frontend/src/app/forgot-password/forgot-password.component.ts)

use_cases.name: User Logout
use_cases.description:
1. Client: Sends GET request to /rest/user/whoami to check authentication status
2. Authentication Handler: Checks if user is authenticated via JWT token (routes/currentUser.ts)
3. Client: Clears JWT token from localStorage and cookie (frontend/src/app/navbar/navbar.component.ts)

use_cases.name: Session Refresh
use_cases.description:
1. Client: Sends GET request to /rest/user/whoami to refresh session
2. Authentication Handler: Verifies JWT token validity (routes/currentUser.ts)
3. Authentication Handler: Returns user information if authenticated (routes/currentUser.ts)
